newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 9-, 12 mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 9-, 12 mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Monday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry nine- and 12-month floating interest T-bills due to a cut in the main interest rate and higher average accepted prices, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 26.94 and 36.29 percent, down from 39.16 and 51.78 percent at the respective auctions a week earlier.
The average accepted prices for the two issues auctioned on Monday were 99.85 and 99.54 percent of par, up from 97.27 and 96.95 percent of par for the two respective maturities auctioned on June 9.
Interest on each of the issues is due at maturity. It equals the central bank main interest rate and is adjusted every time the main rate is changed.
A cut in the central bank main interest rate to 35.76 percent annually from 47.28 percent took effect on Monday.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 7,000 million levs 7,000 million levs
Bids received 42,925 million levs 30,350 million levs
Average price of bids 98.71 pct 98.19 pct
Bids approved 7,000 million levs 7,000 million levs
Average yield to maturity 26.94 pct 36.29 pct
